questions.question: When students board a bus, where should they sit?

options.text: In the back row only after all other seats are filled.
As far from the driver as possible.

questions.correctAnswerText: In the back row only after all other seats are filled.
questions.explanation: Students should fill seats closer to the front first. Sitting near the front is safer in a rear-end collision. Students with special needs should sit near the driver.

questions.question: What should you do when driving through a curve on the skills test?

options.text: Leave your lane if needed to complete the curve.
Slow down after you enter the curve.
Do not look for other vehicles while turning.
Slow down before you enter the curve.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down before you enter the curve.
questions.explanation: Slow down before entering a curve so you do not need to brake while turning. Stay in your lane and keep checking for traffic around you.

questions.question: Which statement is true about pull-ups during the basic vehicle control skills test?

options.text: Points are taken away for each pull-up.
A driver can do three pull-ups per maneuver without penalty.
A pull-up only counts if the driver gets out of the vehicle.
Only too many pull-ups count as errors.

questions.correctAnswerText: Only too many pull-ups count as errors.
questions.explanation: A single pull-up does not cause a penalty. However, doing too many pull-ups will count as errors.

questions.question: How should you complete a driver's side parallel parking maneuver?

options.text: Drive straight forward into the parking space.
Back up past the space, then pull forward into it.
Drive forward past the space, then back into it.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive forward past the space, then back into it.
questions.explanation: Drive past the parking space on your left. Then back into it, bringing the rear of your vehicle as close to the rear of the space as possible. Your vehicle must be completely within the boundaries of the space.

questions.question: What maneuver might you be asked to do during a basic vehicle control skills test?

options.text: Drive straight into a parking space.

questions.explanation: The test may include straight line backing, offset back/right parking, offset back/left parking, driver side parallel parking, conventional parallel parking, and alley docking.

questions.question: When properly adjusted, the flat mirrors on a school bus should allow the driver to see how far behind the bus?
questions.explanation: Proper mirror adjustment is very important for safe bus operation. Flat mirrors should be adjusted so the driver can see 200 feet, or about four bus lengths, behind the bus.

questions.question: During exercises other than straight line backing, how many times can you exit your vehicle to check its position?
questions.explanation: You can exit your vehicle to check its position during any exercise. This is called a "look." During straight line backing, you may do one look. During any other exercise, you may do two looks.

questions.question: What is a "look" during a basic vehicle control skills test?

options.text: Checking the gauges on your dashboard.
Exiting your vehicle to walk back and check its position.

questions.correctAnswerText: Exiting your vehicle to walk back and check its position.
questions.explanation: A look is when you open your door, leave your seat, and walk to the back of the vehicle to check its position. During straight line backing, you may do one look. During other exercises, you may do two looks.

questions.question: What is a passive railroad crossing?

options.text: A crossing with no control devices.

questions.correctAnswerText: A crossing with no control devices.
questions.explanation: A passive railroad crossing has no traffic control devices. The driver must decide whether it is safe to cross the tracks.

questions.question: Where are the blind spots on the left and right side flat mirrors?
questions.explanation: There are blind spots directly below and in front of each outside flat mirror. Another blind spot exists directly behind the rear bumper.

questions.question: If a school bus needs to be evacuated, passengers should:
questions.explanation: During an emergency, the driver must quickly decide which exit is safest. Then the driver must tell all students to use that exit.

questions.question: Where is the overhead rearview mirror located on a school bus?

options.text: On the right side of the bus.
Above the windshield inside the bus.

questions.correctAnswerText: Above the windshield inside the bus.
questions.explanation: The overhead rearview mirror is mounted above the windshield on the driver's side. The driver uses it to watch students inside the bus.

questions.question: Loading and unloading a school bus:

options.text: Does not need to be supervised.
Can be done while the driver talks to another driver.

questions.explanation: More students are hurt during loading and unloading than while on the bus. Drivers must follow safety rules and supervise carefully during these times.

questions.question: When should you adjust a bus's mirrors?

options.text: At the first stoplight after starting your shift.

questions.explanation: Check and adjust all mirrors before you start driving.

questions.question: During a vehicle inspection, you must identify all of the following, except:
questions.explanation: You must check the power steering belt, water pump belt, alternator belt, and air compressor belt. Look for damage, cracks, and looseness. Check all other parts to make sure they work, are secure, and are not damaged or leaking.

questions.question: During the basic vehicle control skills test:

options.text: A pull-up always counts against the applicant.
A pull-up should be completed at least once.
Stopping without changing direction is not a pull-up.
Excessive pull-ups are acceptable to some test administrators.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stopping without changing direction is not a pull-up.
questions.explanation: A pull-up happens when you stop and then drive forward to get a better position. Just stopping is not a pull-up. Too many pull-ups will count as errors.

questions.question: Where should students stay during an emergency?

options.text: On the side of the road near the bus
In a field away from the bus

questions.explanation: In most emergencies, students are safer and easier to control on the bus. Only evacuate if staying on the bus puts them at risk.

questions.question: When should outside mirrors on a school bus be adjusted?
questions.explanation: Check and adjust all mirrors before you start driving. Proper mirrors are important for the safety of all students and other vehicles.

questions.question: How far away should you stop from students at a bus stop?
questions.explanation: Stop at least 10 feet away from students. This makes them walk toward the bus so you can see and watch them.

questions.question: During the on-road driving test, you must do all of the following, except:

options.text: Complete the test without an accident.
Use your cell phone while driving.

questions.correctAnswerText: Use your cell phone while driving.
questions.explanation: During the on-road test, you must wear your safety belt, obey all traffic signs and laws, and drive safely without any accidents.
